sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 374 numbered Disney entries and 68 unnumbered sketch artists are reconciled, retaining actor/character/property text columns and the full sketch-artist roster, including mixed Japanese/Latin names. Paper and Chrome base tiers remain separate; apparent printed spellings, case and clipped property text are preserved. Only the product-page Platinum starting numbering is imported; pack odds and exhaustive parallel-numbering reconciliation remain pending.

sourceSheets.name: Official global/product checklist variants
notes: The product page still links this imported primary PDF. The current global checklist index links a different PDF with the same 442 rows and 15 sections. Both are retained without silently resolving their text differences.
MINTED IN MAGIC MM-PL Pluto: the primary prints Mickey & Friends; the global alternate prints Mickey and Friends.
CS-CN Clarence Nash: the primary heading prints CLARENCE NASH DONALD DUCK CUT SIGNATURE; the global alternate heading prints CLEARANCE NASH DONALD DUCK CUT SIGNATURE.
No other original card/name/property/artist cells differ in the complete physical-column comparison.

parallelSpecifications.name: Starting Platinum base numbering
parallelSpecifications.qualification: The 25-subject paper Platinum tier starts numbered /99; no Chrome variation or other parallel limit is inferred.
